product_intake.title: Krastorio 2 science-tier phase-out does not apply to MIR-generated research
product_intake.source_observation: Maintainer report against the immutable 3.2.5 package. Exact local Krastorio2 2.1.2 runs its final tier-separation pass before MIR; the existing K2SO scenario currently asserts retention of five early/base science packs on research_advanced_circuit.

reproduction.evidence: Immutable 3.2.5 loaded successfully on Factorio 2.1.13 with exact Krastorio2 2.1.2 and K2SO 2.0.13. campaign-evidence.json SHA-256 CE4AC36D3BBC9174965B4FDE3537C734E76E12FDE6F3FFBB6DDE1DAA42F1605A; load-results.json SHA-256 16FFACDB85F47B95E571F37A6F24EE544ECB4A5BC63AFAD8461C32B3CC237241. The capture records 73 of 76 generated streams retaining at least one automation, logistic, chemical, or military science pack; research_advanced_circuit retains automation, logistic, chemical, production, and electromagnetic packs. Source: Krastorio2_2.1.2/prototypes/final-fixes/enforce-science-tier-separation.lua; validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json#local-2-1-krastorio-spaced-out; build/results/terminal-characterization/k2-2.1.2-attempt-02/
